_README: REAL captured output from the 2026-07-23 generation run and guard experiment. Nothing here is hand-written. Every string was produced by the model named in `model`, or is a verbatim record of what the guard did with it. Tests read this instead of invented 'model output' so they exercise prose the model actually wrote, including its failure modes.
run_notes: This run largely FAILED, and the fixtures preserve that rather than hiding it. Of 12 experiment calls: 5 returned truncated JSON because max_output_tokens was shared with the model's thinking budget, 4 hit HTTP 429 when free-tier quota ran out, and only 3 produced usable prose. The generation run failed the same way and produced zero LLM explanations -- its single attempted case fell back to the template. See app/explanation/generator_llm.py MAX_OUTPUT_TOKENS for the fix.
